metadata.title: Pumpkin and Soya Chunk Curry
metadata.description:
Welcome to our Northeast Indian kitchen! Today, we're making a mouth watering Pumpkin and soya curry using MAGGI Magic Ae Masala! This recipe is quick, simple, and packed with flavours that will leave you wanting more. Perfect for a hearty meal, enhanced by the extraordinary taste of MAGGI Magic Ae Masala.
